name: BSP_FoliageSystem_ParseTypeTable
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = foliage system), sole caller 00ad9ac0. Builds a Lua state (00b66bd0, 00b6a020), loads Effects\foliage\FoliageTypes.lua via 00b69d40, pushes the global 'Foliages' and iterates it. Each element has a 'name' field plus indexed sub-entries: a one-based counter is appended by 004caca0 to eight stems built at 00ae8899..00ae8be4 in the order model, modeltype, percent, uptexture, sidetexture, scale, height, topheight. Model branch reads model<N>/modeltype<N>/percent<N>; impostor branch reads uptexture<N>/sidetexture<N>/scale<N>/height<N>/topheight<N>/percent<N>; neither present logs the Hungarian diagnostic 'Foliage %s se modell, se uptexture nincs megadva!'. Installed file has 24 entries over 532 lines and documents modeltype 0 TREE, 1 CORAL, 2 SEAWEED. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md; reports/app_init_world_effects.json.

name: BSP_TextureAtlas_SplitNameMatches
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(ECX = requested descriptor string, EDX = candidate string), AL result; called only from 00af0060 at 00af02dd. Lowercases both sides (004bcc00) and replaces backslash with forward slash (004cad40, constants 00ce7894 and 00ce7898). True on exact case-insensitive equality; false when the candidate is shorter; requires rfind('/') to return the same index on both sides and the directory text to match; requires both names to end in .ats (00d5d23c); otherwise returns equals_ci(stem(request) + '_' (00ce7890), candidate.substr(0, len(request)-3)), both spans measured from the request. One request therefore loads every <stem>_*.ats sibling: the installation has no interface/textures/common.ats but four common_*.ats parts. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_WORLD_EFFECTS.md; reports/app_init_world_effects.json.
